patterns.explanation: person:461 recorded 2 calls on 2026-08-28 against their own baseline of 1.1429 calls per observed day (stdev 0.378 over 7 observed days), giving z = 2.2678, above the configured threshold of 2.0. The absolute excess is 0.8571 calls, which is small in absolute terms against the configured materiality of 2.0 calls. High activity only; low activity is never flagged.

person:461 and person:462 are linked through 2 independent observed channels (CALL, TRANSACTION), each recorded in a separate dataset. Multiple independent channels are harder to explain as coincidence than one channel with many records, which is why the count is over channels and not over records.

Potential transaction pattern requiring review: value returns to its origin along person:461 -> person:462 -> person:461, a closed circuit of 2 persons carrying 95000.0 INR across 2 observed transactions. A circuit is a shape, not a finding; the listed transaction records are the whole of the basis.

Potential transaction pattern requiring review: person:461 sits at the centre of 6 distinct senders paying into one target, across 6 observed transactions totalling 1917175.62 INR (threshold: 5 counterparties). Many counterparties is a shape common to legitimate activity as well; it is a reason to look, not a conclusion.

Potential transaction pattern requiring review: person:461 sits at the centre of one source sending to 10 distinct receivers, across 10 observed transactions totalling 2712145.29 INR (threshold: 5 counterparties). Many counterparties is a shape common to legitimate activity as well; it is a reason to look, not a conclusion.
